scope: Theorem 1.2 of the manuscript “An L² Einstein Gap for Nonnegatively Curved Four-Manifolds” (preprints/An-L2-Einstein-Gap-for-Nonnegatively-Curved-Four-Manifolds-October-5-2026/einstein-gap.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 348 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 3be17e2ac8ba5f5f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 1-2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume Classification Assumption 1.1. There is a universal constant ε0 > 0 with the following property. If (M, g) is a connected, simply connected, smooth closed Riemannian four-manifold with secg ≥ 0 and ∫︂ M ⃓ ⃓ ⃓ ⃓Ricg − Scalg 4 g ⃓ ⃓ ⃓ ⃓ 2 g dµg < ε0, 1 then M is diffeomorphic, without a prescribed orientation, to the standard smooth S4, CP2 , or S2 × S2.
